verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a per-run webhook: you pass webhook_url when starting a run, and Skyvern POSTs to that URL when the run reaches a terminal status. That covers the task/run half of the story without polling. The evidence says nothing about webhooks when browser sessions finish, and the run webhook appears in a single short mention. Missing for 10: webhook notifications for browser session completion, documentation of payload/signing/retry behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get webhook notifications when tasks and sessions finish instead of polling for status

citations.quote: Pass webhook_url when you start a run. Skyvern sends one POST to that URL when the run reaches a terminal status
